method: Linear token ratio applied to completed summary-mode reference footprint: 1.25*prepared input bytes + 3*compressed archive bytes + 2*retained point bytes. Allowances model temporary archival copies and summary/ledger output; uncertainty unknown, not a proven upper bound.
guard: Actual free workspace disk must remain >=8589934592 bytes; forecast does not relax or replace hard guard.
limitations: 512 and 1024 had exact input size/free-disk checks and live guards, but no separately recorded output-growth forecast before execution.
